findings.message: undercroft/plate_up: detail bar 0.61 of Eastward's prop band (18.8 tones, 30.8 shapes a patch against 27.0, 50.36)
findings.fix: add drawn structure in clusters of two or more pixels: parts, joints, wear, texture of the material, small story details (art-style.md, Eastward's level of detail is required)

reviewer.note: docs/reviews/2026-11-08-undercroft-woodland-placed.md findings P-1 to P-3. The pair reads right: up shows the slab proud with its front face, down shows the north lip's shadow in the recess. P-1 fault: the inner panel's cross is a flat one-tone plus sign (Matt's U7 flat target); carve it as a groove with a dark north and west wall and a lit south and east lip. P-2 fault: the frame is a terrazzo of evenly scattered tan 2x2 specks with 1 px crack strokes; use sibling clusters, two or three cracks that start at chips, and chipped corners. P-3 polish: moss is single-tone dark green dashes in a row; give clumps a lit cap and keep them to the low joints. Bar 0.61.
